item.title: Iran vows full military response as global leaders urge restraint after US-Israel strikes
item.description: Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has declared that Tehran will use all military means under its right to self-defence following US and Israeli strikes. World leaders are divided, with Western nations urging restraint while Russia condemns the attacks as violations of international law.

item.title: Iran’s ‘murderous regime’ can’t get hold on nuclear arms: Netanyahu on US-Israel strikes
item.description: Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu defended the joint US-Israel strikes on Iran, calling Tehran’s leadership a “murderous regime” and warning it must never acquire nuclear weapons. He also urged Iranian citizens to rise against their government.

item.title: Global reactions to Iran-Israel-US strikes; Pakistan backs Tehran
item.description: Several countries have responded by urging restraint, calling for an immediate halt to hostilities, and pushing for a return to diplomacy. Pakistan, meanwhile, voiced clear support for Tehran.

item.title: 41 Senior IAS Officers Empanelled for Secretary-Level Posts; Major Bureaucratic Reshuffle Likely
item.description: The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet has approved the empanelment of 41 senior IAS officers for secretary and secretary-equivalent posts at the Centre. The move signals an impending reshuffle in the Union bureaucracy, with key administrative changes expected soon.

item.title: 28 IAS Officers Empanelled For Additional Secretary-Level Posts At Centre; Full List Here
item.description: The Centre has empanelled 28 IAS officers for Additional Secretary and equivalent posts, strengthening senior administrative leadership in key ministries as the government prepares to fill top bureaucratic positions.

item.title: Iran Launches ‘Operation Truthful Promise 4’; What US bases are under attack?
item.description: Iran launched missile and drone strikes on seven US military bases across West Asia under Operation Truthful Promise 4, following joint US-Israel attacks. The escalation has triggered regional tensions, civilian advisories, and heightened military alert across multiple countries.

item.title: UN Security Council to hold emergency meeting on Iran amid military escalation; Full story here
item.description: The UN Security Council will convene an emergency meeting after US-Israel airstrikes on Iran triggered global concern and retaliation from Tehran. Several nations have called for urgent discussions to prevent further escalation in the Middle East.

item.title: Khamenei Alive, Says Iran Foreign Minister Amid Reports of Death After US-Israel Strikes
item.description: Iran’s foreign minister has confirmed that Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei is alive, dismissing reports of his death following US-Israel strikes. Tehran signalled openness to de-escalation even as tensions escalate across the Middle East.

item.title: India ‘deeply concerned’ over situation in Gulf, calls for ‘dialogue and diplomacy’
item.description: India has expressed deep concern over escalating tensions in the Middle East after US-Israel strikes on Iran. New Delhi urged restraint and diplomacy while monitoring the safety of Indian nationals as fears of a wider regional conflict grow.

item.title: Iran’s supreme leader Ali Khamenei’s son Mojtaba Khamenei named successor
item.description: According to reports, the strike allegedly hit the Supreme Leader’s office in Tehran, resulting in the death of the 86-year-old leader.
